_comment_click: The bot double-clicks the sprite above each name tag to open CHARACTER INFO. click_offsets = pixels above the tag text (at 1080p) to try, in order. Game must be 1920x1080, windowed or borderless.
_comment_zones: ignore_zones = [x0,y0,x1,y1] fractions of the screen whose text is never read as a name (minimap, quest helper, chat, hotbar).
_comment_location: Park the bot character in front of the FM portal in Henesys, Channel 10. Players next to it get scanned, then skipped for min_reinspect_seconds (10 min).
_comment_gemini: Optional. If set, the bot asks Gemini to read the Character Info panel only when its local text reader can't agree on a value.
